# Draft:Fédération nationale des communications et de la culture

----
The Fédération nationale des communications et de la culture (FNCC) is a French trade union federation representing workers in the communications, media, culture, and information sectors. It is affiliated with the Confédération générale du travail (CGT), one of France’s major trade union confederations.
History
The FNCC was established in 1979 to bring together trade unions representing employees in the communications and cultural sectors. It emerged from the reorganization of CGT-affiliated unions in response to structural changes in media, telecommunications, and cultural industries.
Since its creation, the federation has played a role in coordinating collective bargaining, labor advocacy, and professional representation across public and private sector employers in communications and culture.
Scope and activities
The FNCC represents workers employed in sectors including:
* Telecommunications
* Postal and delivery services
* Media and journalism
* Publishing
* Broadcasting
* Performing arts and cultural institutions
* Audiovisual and digital content industries
The federation engages in collective bargaining, labor rights advocacy, professional training initiatives, and participation in national labor and cultural policy discussions.
Organization
The FNCC operates as a national federation composed of affiliated unions and sectoral branches. It functions within the organizational framework of the CGT and participates in its congresses and decision-making bodies.
Affiliation
The FNCC is affiliated with the Confédération générale du travail, through which it represents its members at the national and interprofessional levels.
